verified_scope: The web app's Send (a restore played by the browser) and Import (a backup recorded and decoded in the browser), on the device; a failed prediction is kept as failed

predictions.send: The backup the device makes after the browser's Send equals the compiled target exactly (every packet and the whole body)
predictions.import: The project the app makes from its own recording of that backup (Device, Import from PO-33), exported as a project archive, compiles to a state that plays the same as the target: every sound the same codes from the same owner, every pattern byte for byte, the same chain, tempo and swing, and no more pages

session_answers.question: Send: at what level did the transfer succeed, and how many tries did it take? Did the PO-33 ever show ERR? (notes)
Send: after the transfer, did PLAY on the PO-33 play Concrete (a techno beat with a filtered stab)? (yes/no/notes)

limits: One session on one device, with this computer's audio interface and Chrome
The import is judged after the app's own export, which fits clip windows to their samples as Send does; the browser's decode itself is not compared packet by packet
